**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

No Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalty exists anywhere in the Agreement:

- **Payment provisions (§7.1–7.5):** Customer owes only Order Form Fees, collectible transaction taxes, and pre-approved travel at cost; §7.1 even bars unidentified minimum-use or similar charges. §7.3 bars interest on amounts ultimately found not due.
- **Termination (§9.1–9.5, §10.1–10.2, §27.3):** termination rights carry refunds of prepaid Fees, with no early-termination fee, minimum fee, or acceleration; §27.3 is expressly "without penalty." §24.4 also blocks Fee acceleration on Customer change of control.
- **Audit (§22.2):** Customer pays reasonable audit costs and the undisputed shortfall only on a >5% underpayment — recovery of amounts actually owed, not a liquidated or penal sum.
- **§2.1 take-or-pay:** a minimum volume commitment (and inconsistent with §12.3's "no minimum-volume commitment" acknowledgement), which belongs to the minimum-commitment rule; not double-flagged here.

Because the fallback (a capped early-termination fee) is only needed where a Customer-payable liquidated amount is unavoidable, and none is present, no redline was proposed.
